name: @datablit/datablit-js
description: Datablit JavaScript SDK for analytics, rules, and experiments

scripts.publish:dev: npm run version:dev && npm publish --tag dev
scripts.publish:beta: npm run version:beta && npm publish --tag beta
scripts.publish:rc: npm run version:rc && npm publish --tag rc
scripts.dist-tag:latest: npm dist-tag add @datablit/datablit-js@$(npm run version:read --silent) latest
scripts.dist-tag:stable: npm dist-tag add @datablit/datablit-js@$(npm run version:read --silent) stable
scripts.info: npm run build && echo 'Current version:' && npm run version:read --silent && echo 'Built files:' && ls -la dist/
scripts.version:show: echo 'Current package version:' && npm run version:read --silent && echo 'Version that will be embedded in build:' && npm run version:read --silent

author: datablit
